blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two weather systems are forecast to continue bringing rain to various parts of the country on Thursday, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the easterlies will also continue to affect parts of Luzon, bringing rain to several areas.
